name: jobshield-ai
description: Thai Occupation Mobility Network — explainable career path recommender

scripts.lint:py: cd py && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:py: cd py && uv run ruff format .
scripts.build:artifacts: cd py && uv run python -m jobshield.cli.build --mock
scripts.seed:mock: cd py && uv run python -m jobshield.data.mock_data
scripts.build:web: bun build ts/web/src/main.ts --outdir ts/web/dist --target browser && cp ts/web/src/styles.css ts/web/dist/styles.css
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:artifacts
